evals.prompt: I am preparing a release of this public pnpm monorepo. Explain how to review pending Changesets, choose version bumps, run validation, and generate the version commit safely.
evals.expected_output: The response gives the repository preflight, Changesets review and semver guidance, validation commands, changeset versioning command, and generated-diff review before commit.
expectations: Requires a clean, up-to-date main checkout without discarding unrelated changes
Uses pnpm exec changeset status and pnpm ci:version
Includes pnpm lint, pnpm test, and pnpm build:all before versioning
Requires reviewing generated package manifests and changelogs before committing

evals.prompt: What exactly does the adraw publish command do, and what should I verify before and after running it?
evals.expected_output: The response explains ci:release's install/build/login/publish sequence, npm authentication and clean-tree checks, local tag creation, and post-publish verification.
expectations: Identifies pnpm ci:release as the canonical publish command
Describes npm login and changeset publish in its sequence
Says to inspect partial publish results before retrying
Says changeset publish creates local package tags

evals.prompt: After publishing, how do I make the package tags create GitHub releases in this repository?
evals.expected_output: The response explains that tags must be pushed, uses git push origin main --tags, and identifies the @adraw/* tag workflow trigger.
expectations: Uses git push origin main --tags rather than only --follow-tags
Identifies @adraw/* as the release tag pattern
